target: daily count of all placed orders in the extract, including cancelled and undelivered orders; no final-status filter
interval_score: maximum absolute error within a completed 7-day forecast block; finite-sample upper rank; clip lower interval at zero
selection_policy: choose the lowest mean weekly MAE on at most 12 completed past origins; ties use listed model order; evaluation outcomes become usable only after their week ends
limitations: rolling calibration is descriptive under dependence/drift; no guaranteed 90% coverage, live ingestion timestamps, future deployment performance, causal effect, or revenue forecast
